_meta.note: The member dispatch round trip on muse, KAS shape. Driven over stdio by scripts/capture_muse_member_dispatch.py (--mount dispatch, --mode readOnly, --settle 20): session/new carried exactly one element, members.member_dispatch_session_server('probe-member-key') behind mcp_http_relay (stdio is refused -32602), mode readOnly set over session/set_mode. Serve was started trusting the workspace (--trust-workspace: without it serve never dials mounted servers, member-dispatch-no-dial-measured.jsonl). The model called mcp__kirocrew_dashboard__session_status with {} -- serve namespaces dashes to underscores -- raised no session/request_permission (trusted serve auto-settles MCP), and the server answered it: Error: could not read your session roster: 404: Not Found, as the probe key names no live session. The session uuid reads SESSION, run uuids read CALL-<n> in order of appearance, the working directory reads ~/work; available_commands_update, session_info_update and agent_thought_chunk frames are dropped as the corpus requires.
